how: a reading: read as charges the two surviving assignments are exchanged by the flip, and as fields the exchange also needs S <-> S~, which the charges do not see; what could fix the bit is a structure that S <-> S~ does not preserve, such as holomorphy in tau required of a named sector (required of every sector it would exclude both assignments); otherwise it is a free datum. Its prediction by hand for main to test: a computation that uses only the charges will find the bit left. The overlap construction itself it leaves with main
note: Later work bears on the prediction: with the Higgs's twist put into the Szego factor, frame D1 is frame C at shifted charges (web-wb2-d1-01 to -07). Main has not written down whether that confirms the prediction; it should.
